scientific_integrity: Cellular action is free on points and cells; no conclusion is inferred from numerical enumeration alone. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Rational finite-group representations and rational quotient homology only; no integral group-ring lattice classification, integral quotient torsion, or equivariant homotopy equivalence. Uses the published nonequivariant tree homotopy theorem. An unindexed equivalent result remains possible. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove the all-tree theorem.
title: Tree-automorphism characters of Stirling-complex homology
